Description: Caster studies and memorizes the appearance and mannerisms of a being, for later use in a Face Shifting or Change type spell. The caster can only have as many forms studied as he has levels
Allows caster to alter the form of his face. If he has used Study Form on a being he can take on that being's exact form
Caster can alter his entire body to the form of another humanoid race (no increase in mass). This cannot be a specific person. See Section 7.1.11
Caster appears to be of any race he chooses to magical or mental detections
Caster can increase his mass (and usually height) by 10% per level of the caster. However, there is no proportional increase in strength (other than for movement purposes)
As Enlarge, except caster shrinks by 10% per level (to a maximum of 90%) and there is no proportional decrease in strength
As Misfeel Kind, except profession may be misrepresented
Caster can breathe water, air, or gas at will (though only one at a time)
As Change To Kind, except caster can assume any organic form within 1/2 and 2x his mass. The caster does not obtain any special abilities. See Section 7.1.11
[RR Mod: -50] Caster can speak mentally with any sentient being; and to the being it will seem as if the caster was speaking in the being's own language
As Misfeel Kind, except level can be misrepresented (ranging from first level to twice his actual level)
As Change, except a specific being can be duplicated if the being has been Studied
As Misfeel Kind, except target appears to have no presence
Allows caster to use all of the "Misfeel" spells at once
As Change, except caster can alter forms at will, by concentrating for one round/change
As Change to Kind, except for duration
As Change, except for duration
As Misfeel, except caster does not have to concentrate
As Impersonation Change, except for duration
As Impersonation Change, except will last until the caster cancels the spell (or it is dispelled)
As Misfeel, except caster can misrepresent his presence and power, so that he seems to be a minor deity

Caster develops an entire false persona and places his own persona deep in his subconscious. To all detection attempts (except, perhaps, Mind Probe), the caster seems to be the false persona. The caster has no control over his actions, until the set duration is over. The false persona can be a specific person if "Study Form" has been cast once/day (for 30 days) on that person. SPECIAL NOTES See Section 7.1.11 for more on changing forms. MYSTIC BASE 4.7.5 MYSTICAL CHANGE
